value.rationale: The sharp closed-loop stability cost of rank-one pruning is a natural quantitative invariant for low-rank CARE computation: a vanishing residual and eigenvalue truncation error coexist with a sign flip in the closed-loop spectral abscissa, and the best stabilizing rank-one substitute has unbounded relative Frobenius price. The example diagnoses why closed-loop safeguards matter beyond ordinary numerical rank tests.
